basic_details.job_title: ARCI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 29 Driver, Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: International Advanced Research Centre for Powder Metallurgy & New Materials (ARCI) is recruiting candidates for 29 vacancies, including Scientist B (R&D), Officer B (Finance & Accounts), Technical Assistant A, Assistant A, Technician A, and Driver A posts under advertisement number ARCI/HRD/RECT/1/2026. The engagement for Officer B includes a deputation normally not exceeding three years. Qualifications and age limits vary by post. The pay scales range from Pay Level 2 to Pay Level 10 depending on the position. Eligible candidates can submit their online application on or before 16 November 2

age_limit.details: The upper age limits for direct recruitment posts are: | Scientist "B" (R&D): Not exceeding 30 years Officer "B" (Finance & Accounts): Not specified for deputation Technical Assistant "A": Not exceeding 30 years Assistant "A": Not exceeding 28 years Technician "A": Not exceeding 28 years Driver "A": Not exceeding 27 years (Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen)

how_to_apply: Visit the official ARCI careers website at www.arci.res.in/careers/vacancies.
Read the detailed advertisement and check eligibility requirements for the desired post.
Fill out the online application form with accurate personal and educational details.
Upload required documents and certificates as specified.
Submit the online application on or before 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive aims to fill 29 vacancies across multiple posts. The post-wise and discipline-wise distribution of vacancies is detailed below: Note: Two (2) posts will be filled by suitable persons from among the Persons with Disabilities/Divyangjan (OH/HH/VI).

rows.discipline_wise_break_up_details: Deputation for a period normally not exceeding 3 years
Director's Office/Administration & Establishment/Human Resource Development/Finance & Accounts/Stores & Purchase/Liaisoning works (1 post for ARCI Office Gurugram)
Pass in 10th/SSC with valid driving licence

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualifications and eligibility criteria specified for each post:

rows.essential_qualification_experience: B.E./B.Tech. in Engineering or Technology or equivalent from a recognised university or Institute in Metallurgy/Materials Science or Mechanical.

Degree from a recognised university with good academic record or equivalent. Officers working in Central/State Governments/Universities/Recognized Research Institutions/Semi-Government, Statutory or Autonomous Organisations holding analogous posts, or with 5 years service in level 8/level 7 of pay matrix, OR 8 years service in level 6 of pay matrix, with relevant experience.

B.Sc. in Physical Sciences (with Chemistry as one of the subjects); OR Three (3) years full-time Diploma in Metallurgy/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognised university/Institute/Board of Technical Education.

Bachelor's degree from a recognised university/Institute; and Three (3) years' experience in Director's Office/ Administration & Establishment/Human Resource Development/Finance & Accounts/ Stores & Purchase/Liaisoning works in Government Departments/ Scientific Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies/ Academic Institutions.
10th/SSC pass plus 2 years' full-time ITI in Fitter/Turner/Electrician trade; and Three (3) years technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories.

Pass in 10th/SSC; Possession of valid driving licence to drive light and heavy vehicles; Knowledge of motor mechanism (ability to identify and rectify minor defects); Experience of driving a light vehicle for at least 3 years and heavy vehicles for at least 6 years.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limits for direct recruitment posts are: Scientist "B" (R&D): Not exceeding 30 years Officer "B" (Finance & Accounts): Not specified for deputation Technical Assistant "A": Not exceeding 30 years Assistant "A": Not exceeding 28 years Technician "A": Not exceeding 28 years Driver "A": Not exceeding 27 years (Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen)

faq.question: Q1. What is ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ARCI Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the International Advanced Research Centre for Powder Metallurgy & New Materials to fill 29 vacancies across multiple scientific, technical, administrative, and support posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 29 vacancies advertised under advertisement number ARCI/HRD/RECT/1/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Scientist B posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Scientist B (R&D) is not exceeding 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for Technical Assistant A?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Physical Sciences with Chemistry as one of the subjects, or a three-year full-time Diploma in Metallurgy, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for Assistant A posts?
faq.answer: Assistant A posts are placed at Pay Level 5.

faq.question: Q7. Can Ex-Servicemen apply for Driver A posts?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen for the Driver A posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I submit the online application for ARCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official ARCI careers portal at www.arci.res.in/careers/vacancies.
